transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: I sent money to my brokerage account and it hasn't shown up. It's making me nervous.

transcript.speaker: bot
transcript.text: Hello! I'm AIM, the Freedom Broker AI assistant. I can answer questions about products and services, provide information about your accounts, assets and fees, compare information in a table, share your account manager's contact details, and pass your question to our support team.

transcript.speaker: bot
transcript.text: By continuing this conversation, you agree to the collection and processing of your personal data and confirm that you have read the company's Privacy Policy.

transcript.speaker: bot
transcript.text: Do you need help making a transfer, or have you already sent it?

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: I've already sent it. Please connect me to an agent who can check the transfer.

transcript.speaker: bot
transcript.text: Would you like me to connect you with an agent?

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: Yes

transcript.speaker: bot
transcript.text: Please wait. An agent will join the chat shortly.

transcript.speaker: system
transcript.text: Chat transferred to an agent.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: The bank app says the transfer was sent.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Hello, I'm Sam. I understand why you'd want to check. We'll need to verify your identity before we look at the account.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: system
transcript.text: Customer identity verified.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Thanks. What currency did you send?

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: US dollars.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: I've sent the case for review with the currency you provided. We'll follow up in this chat once there's an update.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: Okay, thanks.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: Do you need me to send a screenshot of my bank app?

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Hold off on the screenshot for now. Can you tell me roughly when you sent the transfer?

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: Yesterday evening. It shows as sent on the bank side.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: I've added that timing to the case. The team will check the brokerage side.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: Will I need to explain everything again if I come back later?

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: You can return to this chat. The details you've given me are already in the case.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: Okay, that helps.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: One more thing while I'm here. Where can I download my broker report?

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: In the app, open Reports and Documents, then Broker Report.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: I've got the dates on screen. Can I pick the whole month?

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Yes, select the start and end dates for the period you need, then download the report.

transcript.speaker: client
transcript.text: That worked. I'll wait here for the transfer update.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: You're welcome. We'll follow up here about the transfer. Goodbye!
